title: Principles of Hatchet Melee
summary: Lays out the full-meridian hand axe arts of hooking, cutting and closing for fighters entering true melee.

title: The Close Axe: A Treatise on Hooking and Cutting
summary: Develops hooking and cutting at close range into qi-charged sequences that pull an opponent open.

title: Collected Exercises of the Field-Hatchet
summary: Gathers exercises for projecting a living qi field along the hand axe's edge and poll.

title: Discourse on Cutting Through Cover
summary: Argues and demonstrates how a qi-fielded hand axe splits shields, doors, branches and planked cover.

title: Twin-Court Hatchet Exercises
summary: Trains a hatchet in each hand to attack and guard as a matched pair in dual-track fashion.

title: Hawk-Stoop Hatchet Methods
summary: Teaches diving cuts and swift recoveries of the hand axe modelled on the stoop of the hawk.

title: Basin-Road Hatchet Discourse
summary: Covers hatchet fighting on narrow basin roads and river banks, where footing and reach are always limited.

title: The River-Ford Reckoner of Hand Axes
summary: Reckons each cut, hook and recovery of the hand axe like crossing a ford, step by measured step.

title: The Wind-Sworn Hatchet Reader
summary: Teaches the hand axe as a wind-sworn fighter's quick tool, light in the grip and fast to turn.

title: Oath-Bearing Hatchet Discourses
summary: Sets out hand axe cuts fixed to a sworn bearing, held steady while the qi field answers the wind.

title: Plateau Edge Hatchet Practice
summary: Practises hand axe work on open windswept ground and cliff lips, with no wall to lean on.

title: Gale-Line Treatise of the Short Axe
summary: Treats the short axe's cuts as lines drawn along the gale, joined by a field of qi.
